sites.name: Nobile Rim 1
sites.description: Nobile crater rim candidate at 85.2 S, 36.1 E, on the high polar plateau west of Nobile where the DEM shows broad, rough highland relief rather than a single crater wall. Terrain data here is the regional 80 m/px LOLA DEM only (no 5 m/px near-field coverage), so the horizon is a 100 km regional profile sampled every 80 m.

citations.label: Barker et al. (2021), Improved LOLA Elevation Maps for South Pole Landing Sites
Mazarico et al. (2011), Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography
NASA PGDA, LOLA South Pole landing-site DEMs (5 m/px)
NASA PGDA, LOLA 80S 80 m/px regional DEM

sites.name: Haworth Rim
sites.description: Haworth crater candidate at 87.4 S, 354.8 E; on the regional 80 m/px LOLA DEM this coordinate lies inside the Haworth basin, whose walls dominate the skyline over most azimuths. Terrain data here is the regional 80 m/px LOLA DEM only (no 5 m/px near-field coverage), so the horizon is a 100 km regional profile sampled every 80 m.
